description: Get IPOSignal's X/Twitter social-sentiment reading for a specific IPO — an aggregate of how investors are discussing the stock on X, scored from -1 (bearish) to +1 (bullish) with a label, post tallies, and a one-line summary. The reading is taken once, before listing, and not refreshed: `ageDays` says how old it is and `reliable` is false when too few posts back it. Returns the aggregate signal only, not the underlying posts. Provide exactly one of companyId, symbol, or cik. PREMIUM: paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base); an unpaid call returns the payment terms, and a not-found is never charged. Same data and price as the HTTP endpoint /api/agent/social-sentiment.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros, e.g. 1876042 or 0001876042.

companyId.description: IPOSignal company id (24-character hex), as returned by other IPOSignal responses.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. CRCL. Case-insensitive. Tickers get reassigned, so a response may carry a symbolNote.

name: get_ipo_social_sentiment

ageDays.description: Days since the reading. Readings are taken before listing and not refreshed.

postCount.description: Posts the reading is based on.

reliable.description: False when too few posts back the reading.

symbolNote.description: Present only when the requested ticker is contested: which registrant it belongs to now vs. the record served.

title: IPO social sentiment (premium)
